snippet.title: TrinityS: Early Access Launch Trailer / Steam
snippet.description:
TrinityS early access will be avaliable on  April 28, 2022!
Wishlist now!: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1584690/TrinityS/

- What's TrinityS? -
Indie-us Games' first original indie game.
It is a cooperative (co-op) online action game for three players based on the theme of "positioning". It is a minimalist yet profound game that focuses on extracting only the boss battles of fantasy action RPGs and allowing them to be played continuously. 

- Early access release -
April 28, 2022

- Web -
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1584690/TrinityS/
Official Site: https://www.indie-us-games.co.jp/trinitys
